title: Catalog redirected configuration
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, a Boolean $b$, an input list $x$, and a configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, define a configuration of the redirected machine on the same input. Its state is the catalog redirected state determined by $b$, the state of $c$, and the last output symbol of $c$ if one exists; it preserves the input-head position, work tapes, and work-head positions, and has empty output.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
